en.headline: Hong Kong foil team reach Asian Games quarter-finals
en.dek: Ryan Choi, Cheung Ka-long, Ho Ching-him and Leung Chin-yu beat India 45-27 in the last 16 in Nagoya and next face Uzbekistan.
body: Hong Kong's men's foil team reached the Asian Games quarter-finals on Friday morning, beating India 45-27 in the last 16 in Nagoya.

The squad of Ryan Choi Chun-yin, Cheung Ka-long, Ho Ching-him and Leung Chin-yu is the same combination that took world championships silver. Choi won individual foil silver earlier in these Games; Cheung was eliminated in the individual last 32.

They next meet Uzbekistan in the quarter-finals. Team fencing opened on Friday, with the women's épée squad also in action. Hong Kong's medal tally stood at four gold, 10 silver and nine bronze after Thursday.

zh.headline: 港隊男花團體淘汰印度 亞運闖八強
zh.dek: 蔡俊彥、張家朗、何承謙及梁千雨周五上午在名古屋以45：27擊敗印度，十六強過關後下一場對烏茲別克。
body: 港隊男子花劍團體周五上午在名古屋亞運十六強以45：27擊敗印度，晉級八強。
出場陣容為蔡俊彥、張家朗、何承謙及梁千雨，與世錦賽奪銀的組合相同。蔡俊彥較早前在今屆個人賽摘銀，張家朗則在個人賽三十二強止步。
港隊八強將對烏茲別克。周五劍擊團體賽開鑼，女子重劍隊亦有賽事。截至周四，港隊累積四金、十銀、九銅。
